anomalies.observed: U10.4 (GND1) and U10.5 (GND2) are both connected to net GND; U11.4 (GND1) and U11.5 (GND2) are also both connected to net GND.
anomalies.expected: For isolated CAN transceivers, GND1 (logic side) and GND2 (bus side) must be on separate ground nets (e.g., GND and GND_ISO) to maintain galvanic isolation.

evidence.quote: GND [High Power] : ... U10.4(GND1,power_in) U10.5(GND2,power_in) U11.4(GND1,power_in) U11.5(GND2,power_in) ...
two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (U8, U9) through an isolated CAN transceiver (U11/companion)

anomalies.impact: The galvanic isolation between the logic side and the CAN bus side is defeated, allowing ground loops and losing the protective isolation intended for the CAN interfaces.

anomalies.observed: The anodes of D14, D23, and D4 are tied together on net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW, but this net has no connection to any supply or driver.
anomalies.expected: The LED anodes should be connected to a 3.3V supply (e.g., +3V3 or a switched 3.3V rail) to allow the LEDs to illuminate.
anomalies.impact: D14 (Ethernet LED), D23 (Ethernet LED), and D4 (activity LED) will never light, disabling their indicator functions.

anomalies.observed: R60 pin 2 is on ESTOP_OUT, and D30 pin 4 (A2) is also on ESTOP_OUT. R60 pin 1 connects to D30 pin 2 (K2) on Net-(D30-K2). This places R60 in parallel with the LED between ESTOP_OUT and a floating node.
anomalies.expected: R60 should connect the cathode of D30's second LED to GND (or a return) to complete the current path, typically as a current-limiting resistor to ground.

evidence.quote: ESTOP_OUT : D30.4(A2,input) J13.6(Pin_6,passive) J2.6(Pin_6,passive) R60.2(passive) U36.4(Y,output)

anomalies.impact: The second LED in D30 (likely an e-stop indicator) will never light, and ESTOP_OUT does not have the intended LED load.

parsed.summary: The design files contain three anomalies: the isolated CAN transceivers have their logic and bus grounds tied together, defeating isolation; the anodes of D14, D23, and D4 are on a floating net with no supply; and R60 is miswired so D30's second LED has no return path to ground.
